# Third-party notices

Fidelis integrates unmodified upstream tools. Their names, authors and licenses remain their own.

- **Fiji**: the Fiji contributors; https://github.com/fiji/fiji. Current GPLv3 license text and component exception list are preserved as licenses/Fiji-GPL-3.0.txt and licenses/Fiji-LICENSES.txt. The installed assembly's Maven metadata is fiji-installed-pom.xml. Full distribution-specific notices remain in the external Fiji/licenses directory and JAR metadata.
- **ImageJ**: Wayne Rasband / NIH; https://github.com/imagej/ImageJ. Preserve licenses/ImageJ-LICENSE.txt, which contains its public-domain disclaimer.
- **ImageJ2 and SciJava**: upstream contributors; licenses differ by component. See Fiji's component metadata and https://imagej.net/licensing/.
- **faster-whisper**: SYSTRAN and contributors; https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper. MIT text copied verbatim from v1.2.1 to licenses/faster-whisper-MIT.txt.
- **Whisper**: OpenAI and contributors; https://github.com/openai/whisper. MIT text preserved in licenses/Whisper-MIT.txt. The Systran converted tiny.en model card declares MIT; the exact model revision and file hashes are recorded under external/.
- **Python dependencies**: the speech worker's installed license/notice files are copied verbatim under licenses/speech; speech-packages.json records names, versions, project URLs and notice-file hashes. The verification harness needs Pillow (licenses/verification). Penny's Node.js dependencies keep their LICENSE files in node_modules; exact versions are in package-lock.json. A packaged release must include applicable notices from the actual bundle.
- **Java**: the pinned portable Fiji runtime includes Zulu OpenJDK and its legal directory; preserve it when redistributing Fiji.

No upstream implementation source has been pasted into Fidelis. License copies are attribution/reference material, not a declaration that all dependencies share one license. Original Fidelis code is licensed under Apache-2.0, as scoped in the repository's root LICENSE and NOTICE files (2026-10-17). That licence does not cover any upstream component listed here. A bundled redistribution policy (Fiji, JDK, speech runtime and models) has not been chosen.

Synthetic two-squares.png is generated by fixtures/create_fixture.py. invert-command.wav was generated locally with Windows System.Speech from the text “Invert the image.” It is a test stimulus, not a recording of the user and not an accuracy benchmark. Preserve attribution and model/runtime pins when sharing the demo.
